Premium Residences near Aeroport Station
A Home for the Idea-Driven
The MASTERS, a new luxury residential building in Moscow’s prestigious north, is located at 16 Viktorenko Street. Nestled in a quiet, intimate neighborhood near the parks and architectural landmarks of the Khodynka area, it is just 15 minutes from the Kremlin. This serene, private enclave is surrounded by lush green spaces and welcoming residential courtyards.
The neighborhood has long been home to brilliant minds in aviation and science, a creative hub for artists and musicians, and the birthplace of breakthrough discoveries and cultural masterpieces.
We are designing an environment for those who will carry on this legacy. The MASTERS Residences provide a sanctuary for modern leaders and creatives. It is a place where architecture inspires, panoramic views energize, and dynamic shared spaces foster the exchange of ideas to help bring your vision to life.
The streets surrounding The MASTERS are steeped in a rich legacy of creative innovation — a heritage that has shaped the neighborhood’s unique identity for generations. A brief fifteen-minute stroll reveals a stunning tapestry of architectural history: the famous Petrovsky Palace, the unique Sokol Artists' Village, striking Constructivist neighborhoods, rare pre-Empire residential buildings of the 1930s, and the grand, ceremonial facades of Leningradsky Avenue.

The MASTERS is positioned near one of Moscow’s most highly connected transit hubs. With multiple public transit lines converging nearby, navigating the city is effortless, whether you’re taking transit or driving your own vehicle. Enjoy easy access to three metro stations (Aeroport, Dinamo, and CSKA), the Zorge MCC station, major bus routes along Leningradsky Avenue, and the Third Transport Ring. Staying mobile in the city has never been easier.

Architectural design by GAFA Architects
The eight-story buildings front the greenbelt, while the 25-story towers offer 360-degree panoramic views. Featuring a crystal-inspired architectural design, the intricate facade details create a stunning interplay of light and shadow.

The development features a variety of window configurations, including striking bay windows and floor-to-ceiling windows. Accent lighting elevates the building’s striking silhouette, transforming it into a modern landmark.

Landscaping
Landscape Concept
The grounds feature two primary spaces — the greenbelt and the private courtyard — designed for relaxation, family time, or entertaining friends.

The greenbelt embraces a natural, organic design with dedicated areas for fitness, play, meditation, and outdoor work. It is designed to seamlessly integrate into the neighborhood’s larger green ecosystem.

The private courtyard serves as an exclusive outdoor retreat, featuring light, natural palettes where privacy and serenity perfectly balance with social lounge areas.

Private Courtyard
Multi-level landscaping featuring over 500 trees and shrubs carefully selected for year-round seasonal blooming. Natural stone pathways, ambient lighting, and bespoke outdoor furniture evoke the feel of a private estate. Residents enjoy access to a shaded pergola with a water feature, game tables, and an interactive toddler play area.
View gallery
linear
park
Dozens of mature trees have been preserved, layered with native plants and meadow grasses to create an immersive, forest-like environment. Organic materials — wood, stone, and gravel — are integrated throughout.

Children enjoy a dedicated play area, sensory paths, and a clover lawn. Adults have access to sun loungers, an outdoor gym, ping-pong, a larch-wood yoga deck, and a botanical herb garden. For remote work, an outdoor co-working space is equipped with charging stations. Evenings can be spent at the artfully lit amphitheater, framed by weeping willows.
The Art of Design
The interiors at The MASTERS are a seamless extension of the architectural vision. Soft, curved lines define both the luxury finishes and the custom furnishings.
1 / 5
A stunning 160 m² double-height volume featuring 6 m ceilings and floor-to-ceiling windows. The focal point of the lobby is a custom sculptural staircase. The interior is elevated with bespoke furniture, elegant indoor landscaping, and curated art installations.
Grand Lobby & Main Reception
Light neutral tones paired with terracotta accents evoke warmth and comfort, ensuring residents feel they are not stepping out of their home when entering the lobby, but rather remaining within a seamless, secure sanctuary.
Color palette
Ceilings finished in sophisticated, deep terracotta tones harmonize with natural wood elements. Accents of refined, warm-toned metals capture and reflect ambient light, creating a beautiful interplay of highlights.
Materials
A layered, multi-level lighting design featuring recessed spotlights, custom statement pendants, and concealed LED cove lighting to set the perfect mood.
Lighting
All premium finishes (venetian plaster, porcelain tile, and wood veneers) meet strict fire safety codes and are designed for lasting durability.

FAMILY MORTGAGE
A federally subsidized mortgage program for Russian citizens with children under 7 or a child with disabilities.
• Fixed 6% interest rate for the life of the loan
• Down payment from 20.1%
• Maximum loan amount: 12,000,000 RUB
• Loan terms up to 30 years
COMBO FAMILY MORTGAGE
A mortgage program allowing buyers to secure funds exceeding standard government loan limits at standard lending rates.

• Interest rates starting from 6.97%
• Down payment from 20.1%
• Maximum loan amount: 30,000,000 RUB
• Loan terms up to 30 years
STAGED-DRAW MORTGAGE (Milestone Financing)
A structured financing program for pre-construction properties. The loan is disbursed in scheduled installments (tranches) aligned with development milestones. Interest accumulates only on the drawn amount, significantly reducing your monthly payments during the construction period.

• Interest rates from 17%
• Down payment from 20.1%
• Maximum grace period up to 24 months
DEVELOPER SUBSIDIZED RATE PROGRAM
Conventional mortgage program with developer-funded interest rate buy-down. Financed by Alfa-Bank JSC (Gen. License of the Central Bank of the RF No. 1326 dated Jan 16, 2015). APR ranges from 18.723% to 21.525%, with a contract rate of 18.29% APR for 30 years. Requires a down payment from 20.1% and loan terms from 3 to 30 years. Valid for purchases through authorized Alfa-Bank partners for loan amounts from 600,000 to 50,000,000 RUB, subject to borrower’s life and property insurance. Details at alfabank.ru (https://www.google.com/url?q=https://alfabank.ru/&sa=D&source=editors&ust=1 779 269 664 584 919&usg=AOvVaw2Lum2HPPuk2kHe7RsAP-hj). Capital Group’s portfolio spans over 11 million sq. m. of completed, under-construction, and planned developments. Key landmarks include the flagship Badaevskiy complex on Taras Shevchenko Embankment, the Zolotoy residential quarter on Sofiyskaya Embankment, and the Capital Towers and OKO skyscrapers. Over its history, the developer has played a pivotal role in shaping the skyline of modern Moscow.

The developer specializes in large-scale master-planned developments, consistently contributing to the evolution of the urban landscape. Capital Group is also one of the largest private developers leading the preservation and adaptive reuse of historic cultural heritage sites, with over 55,000 sq. m. of historic preservation completed.

Capital Group’s developments and initiatives are routinely recognized with top honors at prestigious domestic and international industry awards.
For over 30 years, Capital Group has developed Moscow’s most complex, unique, and iconic architectural landmarks, solving the challenges of 21st-century urban growth. The company is a recognized leader in business, premium, and ultra-luxury residential properties, mixed-use developments, and high-rise towers.
